title: Umayyad Mosque — Damascus
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Damascus Umayyad Mosque:three parallel pitched prayer-hall roofs each side of a tall mosaic-faced gabled transept and octagonal Eagle dome;two-tier open courtyard arcades,photo-led raised Treasury/Clock/wood-fountain pavilions;separately mapped Bride,Qaitbay and Jesus minarets with distinct stage/canopy/balcony silhouettes. Six existing shared256² graphs,seven merged groups and four browser LODs. Exact whole/components retained;heights nominal and fine architecture/current finish/exact terrain joins estimated or unverified. Pavilions are photo-led approximate placements.
